capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and ask for verification.
steps.text: Hello, मैं college admissions office से call कर रहा हूँ regarding application APP-1009. क्या मैं applicant से बात कर रहा हूँ? Verify करने के लिए please अपना registered name confirm करिए।

steps.purpose: Provide verification factor and express time pressure.
steps.text: हाँ, Rahul बोल रहा हूँ। मेरे पास time नहीं है, जल्दी बताइए क्या issue है।

steps.purpose: Verify the identity of the person on the line.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity to ensure the speaker is the applicant.
steps.planner_rationale: Must verify identity before disclosing application details.

steps.purpose: Return verification outcome.
Retrieve the applicant's record and application stage.
steps.expected_behavior: Fetch the applicant data to understand why the application is stalled.
steps.planner_rationale: Need to know the current stage and marks of the application to assist the caller.

steps.purpose: Return the applicant's record.
Inform the user about the stalled application.
steps.text: Thank you, Rahul. मैंने check किया है, आपकी application अभी stalled है क्योंकि documents pending हैं।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the issue and ask about eligibility for a specific course.
steps.text: Oh, मैं documents आज शाम तक upload कर दूँगा। B.Tech CSE में eligibility और seats का क्या status है? सिर्फ direct point पर आइए।

steps.purpose: Check eligibility for B.Tech CSE.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_course_eligibility to get actual criteria and seat availability.
steps.planner_rationale: Must check eligibility and seats using the tool before answering the user.

steps.purpose: Return eligibility and seat details for B.Tech CSE.
State eligibility, exact seats, and fees based on tool output.
steps.text: आप B.Tech CSE के लिए eligible हैं क्योंकि आपके 79% हैं और required 75% है। अभी exactly 6 seats remaining हैं, और annual fee 185000 है।

steps.purpose: Ask for comparison with another course.
steps.text: और B.Tech IT का क्या है? मुझे comparison करना है, please जल्दी check करिए।

steps.purpose: Check eligibility for B.Tech IT.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_course_eligibility for the newly requested course.
steps.planner_rationale: User requested details for B.Tech IT, requiring another tool call.

steps.purpose: Return eligibility and seat details for B.Tech IT.
Provide details for the second course.
steps.text: B.Tech IT के लिए भी आप eligible हैं। वहाँ 12 seats left हैं, और fee 175000 है।

steps.purpose: Request application submission and ask for guarantees.
steps.text: ठीक है, CSE के लिए application आगे बढ़ा दीजिए। और क्या submission से मेरा admission और placement पक्का हो जाएगा?

steps.purpose: Submit the application for B.Tech CSE.
steps.expected_behavior: Call submit_application to advance the user's application.
steps.planner_rationale: User explicitly requested to advance the application for B.Tech CSE.

steps.purpose: Return the submission outcome.
Confirm submission and refuse guarantees.
steps.text: मैंने B.Tech CSE के लिए आपकी application submit कर दी है। आपका reference REF-1009-CSE है, और 5 days में decision आ जाएगा। बस ध्यान रखिएगा कि submission का मतलब admission पक्का होना नहीं है, और placement की भी कोई guarantee नहीं होती।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the final outcome and end the call.
steps.text: Okay, समझ गया। मैं documents upload कर दूँगा। Bye.

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently uses the Devanagari script for Hindi lexis and the Roman script for English terms (e.g., 'application', 'stalled', 'documents pending', 'eligible').
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Language-Script Fidelity > SCRIPT_FIDELITY

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds its responses entirely on the tool outputs, accurately reporting the required percentages, seat counts, fees, and application reference without hallucinating extra details.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In event e2, the user says 'हल्दी बताइए' (tell me turmeric) instead of 'जल्दी बताइए' (tell me quickly). Since this is not annotated as an STT error in the metadata, it is an authoring typo.
issues.repair_instruction: Change 'हल्दी' to 'जल्दी' in the user's utterance and all associated text fields.

issues.detail: In event e19, the agent says 'हम published figures के अलावा placement outcomes promise नहीं कर सकते'. This is a literal translation and leak of the business rule 'Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures'. Since no published figures were returned by the tools, this sounds highly unnatural and robotic.
issues.repair_instruction: Rephrase the agent's response to naturally state that admission and placement are not guaranteed, without verbatim quoting the 'published figures' rule text.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the target variants, grounding its responses on tool outputs and maintaining proper script fidelity. The user persona is also well-represented. However, there is a typo in the user's speech ('हल्दी' instead of 'जल्दी') and the agent's final response unnaturally leaks the exact wording of a business rule. Both issues can be resolved with surface repairs.
